'''Hem Dazon''', known in his youth as '''Kal Nkai''', was a [[Salt/Legends|salt]]-addicted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]]. As a result, his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] became [[Color/Legends|yellow]],<ref name="CCG" /> he was ill-tempered, and his addiction caused him to develop tremors in his hands.<ref name="H2H" /> He spent most of his time in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he spent all of his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on salt and [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]]. He was present in the cantina when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] first met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and he was sitting with [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]], [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]], and [[Braconnor Bakiska/Legends|Braconnor Bakiska]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Biography==
Kal Nkai was born on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]]. His family raised him on their homestead where they hunted for the underground gastric pods used by Cona's [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life to synthesize [[Water/Legends|water]]. Their homestead was located near a family [[Nest (Arcona)|nest]] which was within twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of a [[Grand Nest]]. During Kal Nkai's early life, a long and violent [[Water war (Cona)|war]] broke out between his Grand Nest and an adjacent one over the scarcest resource on the planet, water. Kal Nkai's father, [[Kal Mpon]], firmly believed that fighting was a futile effort that wasted time the Arcona could be spending fighting their common enemy, dehydration.<ref name="SCR" />

As the strain of war increased their hive's thirst and made their water pod hunting grounds less safe, Kal Mpon decided it was time to abandon their homestead and head for lands they could settle peacefully. To leave their homeland, Kal Nkai's family had to trek through a stretch of dense [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] wilderness. Since Kal Nkai was only a child when they left, he couldn't find water on his own because he had yet to learn the difference between helpless and harmful plant life. As the family patriarch, Kal Mpon accepted the sole responsibility of locating water and testing plants for defense mechanisms for his family. Despite his vast experience, Kal Mpon was wholly unprepared for the new life forms he encountered in the wilderness. When he attempted to extract water from a seemingly defenseless plant, he unknowingly activated a defense mechanism that emitted an odorless [[Nerve toxin/Legends|paralyzing gas]]. Kal Nkai would find his father's body next to the plant a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later.<ref name="SCR" />

[[File:Cona_NEGAS.jpg|250px|thumb|left|Dazon's homeworld of Cona]]
With no water and and no experience in extracting it from the hostile plant life, Kal and his [[Kal Nkai's mother|mother]] grew desperate. Having heard of off-worlder [[Mining/Legends|prospecting]] settlements on Cona, Kal and his mother ventured to the nearest one and offered their services to them in exchange for water. The [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] agreed to hire Kal full-time as a package runner. It didn't take long for Kal to realize the packages he was delivering were full of [[Salt/Legends|salt]], a highly illegal substance on Cona that had an addictive hallucinogenic effect on Arconas when ingested. While Kal knew the harsh legal consequences for salt [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], he felt he had a responsibility to support his mother and decided to play ignorant. Over time, the salt residue on the packages seeped into his skin and eroded his resistance to trying it. Kal eventually gave in and became hooked. Being in such close contact to the source, he used more and more. He continuously denied having an addiction and believed that so long as his salt consumption didn't interfere with his work or income, he was fine.<ref name="SCR" />

Noticing Kal's addiction, the prospectors teased him with stories of their homeworld covered in [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] made up of the two most sought-after substances on Cona, salt and water. Kal Nkai's mind raced, and he decided he wanted to leave Cona. When it came time for the prospectors to return to their world with their [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to stock up on more water, Kal briefly fabricated the benefits of his leaving to his mother and wished her farewell. He then accompanied the prospectors on their flight across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The trip was full of trade stops and layovers, one of which being the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley Spaceport]] on Tatooine. It was during this stop that Kal learned of his mother's passing. Grief and helplessness drove him from the [[Freighter/Legends|ship]] and into the cantina where he mourned for nearly four [[Standard day/Legends|days]] straight. The ship's crew tried to pull him back to the ship so they could make their next stop, but Kal wouldn't budge because he wasn't ready to move on and was absolutely unwilling to return to Cona.<ref name="SCR" /> 

The prospectors left without Kal, stranding him with only two weeks of [[Ration pack/Legends|provisions]]. When he eventually ran out, he was forced to take up [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farming]]. Kal was naturally suited for this trade because his heat sensors and multi-band vision allowed him to locate subsurface stores and water pockets much easier than other farmers who had to probe and survey for them. He could have made a fortune off moisture farming, but Kal wasn't looking to succeed, only to survive. He used his money earned working as a moisture farmer<ref name="SCR" /> and desert [[Scout/Legends|scout]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Hem Dazon}}</ref> to pay for his minimum needs while what little extra he had left went to molded salt licks and juri juice from the cantina. At some point before or during his arrival on Tatooine, Kal Nkai came to be known as Hem Dazon. Hem's golden-colored eyes, caused by his salt addiction, led many cantina regulars to nickname him "Goldeye." Hem Dazon spent most of his free time sharing his misery with the other denizens of the cantina day and night.<ref name="HOL" /> When Luke Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] entered Chalmun's Cantina shortly [[0 BBY/Legends|before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a 16-year-old<ref name="SCR" /> Hem Dazon was seated with Bom Vimdin, Pons Limbic, Arleil Schous, and Braconnor Bakiska.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Hem Dazon had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin,<ref name="HOL" /> weighed 72 kilograms, and stood at 1.65 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="H2H" /> Dazon's salt addiction caused his eyes to turn yellow, his temper to turn foul, and debilitating tremors to develop in his hands.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Hem Dazon (Cantina Patron)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569495/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2-469-Hem-Dazon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Demhazon.jpg|thumb|250px|Hem Dazon's appearance in the Holiday Special.]]
Hem Dazon was played by uncredited makeup artist [[Laine Liska]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="SW-SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog|date=2015-04-17|nolive=1}}</ref> The Arcona present in ''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' was not immediately identified as Dazon until the [[Star Wars Blog]] article, [[The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who]], which stated that Dazon was also present in the special.<ref name="Who's Who">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref>

In [[1994]], a screen saver from ''[[Star Wars Screen Entertainment]]'' identified this character as "Kal Nkai", and included many more details about the character's background. Though later sources retconned a number of other characters' differing names in ''Screen Entertainment'' as aliases, no source has done so for Dazon. Though biographical details of some characters in the screen saver were contradicted by later material, only Dazon's name was shown to be different.<ref name="SCR" />

The character received the most votes in a poll given in [[Star Wars Insider 48|''Star Wars Insider'' 48]] asking fans who, among about two dozen obscure [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] and [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] characters, they would like to see made into an action figure.<ref name="SWI 48">{{InsiderCite|48|The Last Page}}</ref> According to [[Star Wars Insider 50|''Star Wars Insider'' 50]], Hem Dazon beat out [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]] 224 votes to 205.<ref name="SWI 50">[[Star Wars Insider 50|''Star Wars Insider'' 50]] {{C|From the Editor's Desk}}</ref> Both characters were later made into action figures by [[Hasbro]] ― Tessek in the [[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|''Power of the Jedi'']] collection in [[2001]],<ref name="Power">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Tessek|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjtessek.asp}}</ref> and Dazon in [[Star Wars: The Saga Collection|''The Saga Collection'']] in [[2006]].<ref name="Saga">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=#033: Hem Dazon|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tsc033hemdazon.asp}}</ref>
